[b]Disclaimer!
[/b]
Credit for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4582]NPC Adventures[/url] belongs to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68185132]purrplingcat[/url] of course! the compatibility patch only contain edits that are necessary for setting up the mod to read in and use my custom spriteframe for fishing, and a couple of personal edits to optimise Abilgail's output.
[b]to be exact it only overwrites edited files and is incomplete and disfunctional on its own [/b]
[b]so you need to have NPC Adventures installed before it for it to work![/b]
[b]and since NPC Adventures have been discontinued, this will only work with the legacy version that is available only for SDV v1.5.6. [/b]
[b]Will not have a SDV v1.6+ compatible version. [/b]
 
that said. my personal attribute settings have been balanced for "dungeon-crawler" gameplay style, for end game and postgame dungeons, like Vulcano, Crimson Badlands, boss monsters, moon misadventures, so on high combat skill level, she might be too feisty for your preferences, especially if you don't have combat oriented mod content installed. if you don't like it, you can always edit her parameters in the [i]...[/i][i]\NPC Adventures\NpcAdventure\assets\companions\Abigail.json[/i] file to fit your own preferences. but be careful about the formatting!

since there is no valid substitute for NPC Adventures that incorporates fishing sprites as of yet, these fishing sprites will not be used ingame unless a specific mod calls for them for events, or in their features, but so far no such mod have been released (that i know of).
having those extra spriteframes will not affect your game negatively, i don't know of any mod collisions regarding to these frames but if you experience anything like that feel free to reach out and i will see what i can do to troubleshoot the problem.

as per request i made a set of alternative portraits that are more in line with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits[/url] albeit not as pastel in vibe it follows the general aesthetic of Nyapu while being mostly corresponding to my spritework. but since Nyapu's current v1.6 ready vanilla sprites have no individual toggle-ability , you actually have to remove the Abigail.png, Abigail_Winter.png and Abigail_Beach.png portrait files from the assets of that mod manually since otherwise their mod will take priority over mine.
hopefully it will suit your tastes, please enjoy! :D
